name: tibial flexion stretch on wall bar
description: A stretch using a wall bar to flex the ankle and lengthen the muscles of the lower leg.
instructions: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
